messages:
emma_marketing: Quick sync — we need final links and the tiny changelog snippet for the Spark launch post. Engineering: can we lock the canary window and the fallback text today? Draft here: https://docs.redwood.com/drafts/spark-launch

devon_eng: can do. Changelog draft below — keeping it short. also need confirmation on model variant names and fallback policy.

devon_eng: ```
model: redwood/spark-v1
changes: improved batching, KV-cache warmup, quant-friendly kernels
fallback: spark-lite (reduced perf, lower mem)
notes: tuned for 2-8 token chunks typical of our prompts
```

sara_pm: Proposed schedule: marketing publish Wed 09:00 PT. Canary start Tue 22:00 PT for 12h, then 4h ramp, full at Wed 15:00 PT. Any objections?

devon_eng: schedule sounds fine. request: please reserve a 2-hour freeze before canary for last infra checks. I'll coordinate with oncall.

deploy-bot: heads-up: canary window request registered — will attempt to schedule maintenance freeze before start. ping @devon_eng to approve.

liam_sales: Can we include a webinar CTA in the launch post? We'll route inbound leads to spark-webinar@redwood.com and the signup form: https://forms.redwood.com/spark-webinar. Also want a short blurb for sales playbook.

emma_marketing: yes — webinar CTA going in. Bench narrative: need 2–3 sentences highlighting latency + cost wins vs baseline. Devon, can you confirm a concise stat we can cite (no raw tables)?

devon_eng: high-level number: ~30% lower per-token cost with batching + quant; 1.2x reduction in median latency vs baseline config at typical prompt sizes. Draft copy: "Spark delivers ~30% lower per-token cost while maintaining comparable 99th-percentile latency to our baseline." ok to use?

sara_pm: add a line about rollback: automatic fallback to spark-lite + cross-region routing if GPU pool saturates. Also link to rollout runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/spark/rollout

emma_marketing: perfect. final checks: legal review if we mention specific customers or comparative benchmarks? anyone?

liam_sales: nothing customer-specific in the post. If we quote competitor names we need legal — we won't.

devon_eng: I'll upload the final changelog file to /releases/spark/ by 16:30 PT today. tagging QA to run quick sanity tests after the canary starts.

emma_marketing: thanks — I'll finalize the post copy and update the draft doc with the final links. final ask for eng: drop the exact model-tag and a 1-line fallback description in the changelog so marketing can insert it verbatim.

devon_eng: will do.

liam_sales: circulating draft to GTM channels now :rocket:

emma_marketing: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the final publish checklist in #marketing once deploy-bot confirms the canary schedule.
